name: Barcelona Games World
blurb: Barcelona's former consumer video game expo at Fira de Barcelona; it has not run since 2019 and was succeeded by the separate NiceOne Barcelona event.
notes: The official domain no longer resolves (net::ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT from this session's renderer, and a direct fetch got ECONNREFUSED, tried on 2026-10-05). A web search (2026-10-05) indicates Barcelona Games World's last edition was 2019 and that the brand has been inactive since, with Fira de Barcelona's gaming event continuing instead as 'NiceOne Barcelona' (a distinct event/id, not covered here). No 2026/2027 Barcelona Games World edition was found anywhere, so this is recorded as inactive rather than 'nothing announced yet'.
